card.name: Spot just before a duration number
card.fires_on: The space or small word (for, just, by, up to, approximately) right before a number that will give a length of time or an amount, such as 3 hours, 45 mins or 24 hours.

modes.label: Before a time span
modes.description: The gap just before a number followed by hours, minutes or days.

modes.label: Small word before a duration
modes.description: Words like for, just or by that lead into a time length.
modes.example: It is usually worn<< for>> 24 hours, even while sleeping

modes.label: Before a quantity
modes.description: The gap before a price or dose number after a phrase like up to or ranging from.
modes.example: with prices ranging from<< >>200 baht per night to

card.writes: It favors words for spans of time like hours, days and half an hour, and disfavors words for daily or recurring schedules.
card.plain: It fires right before a number that says how long something lasts, like 3 hours or 45 minutes.
